lake_description: records 给定 mention/context 和完整报告路径；catalog 为578技术，entity-definitions 为1266实体的定义投影。entity_context 过程示例、label/title/link/id 均不从源标注行公开。原报告自身ID/名称保留。 湖保留全部120报告，本批正链接来自112报告；不由此声称完整报告技术发现。

output_contract.value: Ranked, duplicate-free list of public catalog label_id strings; singleton for HSCodeComp/UDRP. Empty OK is allowed for set-valued tasks. ABSTAIN uses null value and nonempty reason.
output_contract.evidence_refs: Optional list of public relative file paths. Existence is checked; evidence sufficiency is not inferred.
output_contract.ranking: Order is prediction rank, not source gold order. No confidence values are required.

queries.request: For every supplied mention and its context, use its complete report and frozen definitions to return the ATT&CK technique ID(s) it denotes. Boundaries and technical-mention selection are given. This is conditional linking of published positive annotations, not end-to-end detection, negative detection, or a complete report inventory. Preserve subtechnique specificity: use Txxxx.xxx, without collapsing to the parent. Return a duplicate-free list.
queries.gold: 专家技术URL映射为ATT&CK ID；不按父技术折叠，粒度与论文部分实验不同

queries.request: 返回链接到指定技术的提及清单，并关联所属报告
queries.gold: Derived from the same Q1 labels; not independent gold

queries.request: 对本批给定提及按报告归并技术集合，同时区分提及数与报告数
queries.gold: Derived from Q1; partial groups explicitly marked incomplete

queries.request: 返回未完成记录及原因，并报告全量coverage；缺事实和运行失败均需保留原因，不当负例。
queries.gold: No independent gold; this is execution accounting, not missing-fact correctness

scientific_boundary: 5 primary tasks across five lakes; derived queries are not extra datasets, independent labels or observed execution families. No model runs or measured K.
limitations: 3348条源TECHNIQUE正链接中11条指向软件，另18条技术链接缺KG；原gold全部保留，29条不在578技术输出catalog中，不能将不可达标签当模型语义错误。湖含120报告，当前给定提及覆盖112报告。原文保留明示ID捷径。
